name: Solidity Security Review
description: An agent skill that audits Solidity contracts step by step: scope, tests, static analysis, a full checklist, proof-of-concept tests for every serious finding, and a severity-ranked report.
readme:
A skill for the DevStation CLI, the web Coding Agent and Claude Code that turns "is this contract safe?" into a real review.

What the agent does with it
- Fixes the scope to a commit, builds, runs the tests and coverage, and Slither when available
- Maps roles, value flows and invariants before hunting
- Works through a 40-point checklist: access control, reentrancy, tokens, arithmetic, oracles and MEV, signatures, DoS, upgradeability, QIE specifics
- Proves every High or Critical finding with a failing Foundry test
- Writes AUDIT.md from the included report template, with severity, location, impact, proof and fix

Getting started
1. Buy it, then press Open the skill and download the solidity-audit folder: SKILL.md, checklist.md, report-template.md.
2. Put the folder at .devstation/skills/solidity-audit in your project, or ~/.devstation/skills for every project. .claude/skills works too.
3. In the DevStation CLI, run: /solidity-audit review the contracts in src
4. In the web Coding Agent, upload the folder into the workspace, then ask: Follow .devstation/skills/solidity-audit/SKILL.md to review src.
5. Read AUDIT.md, then ask the agent to fix findings one at a time.
